completes $10.8B Beazley acquisition Oct 2, 2026 Switzerland-headquartered Zurich Insurance Group AG has completed its $10.8 billion acquisition of U.K.-based Beazley plc, The Royal Gazette reported. The transaction creates a specialty insurance business with about $15 billion in pro-forma gross written premiums.
